upstream_servers.description: List of DoT upstream servers to use. Each entry specifies the IP address, optional FQDN for TLS authentication, and optional SPKI pinset for strict mode.

round_robin_upstreams.description: Whether to distribute queries across all upstreams (true) or use them in ordered fallback (false).

listen_addresses.description: IP addresses to bind the local DNS listener to. Include '0.0.0.0' or '::' to accept remote queries (not recommended for privacy).

tls_query_padding_blocksize.description: Padding blocksize (bytes) for EDNS0 TLS query padding.

listen_port.description: Local port to listen on for DNS queries (standard DNS uses port 53).

dnssec.description: Whether to enable DNSSEC validation. Note: this config uses 'dnssec: GETDNS_EXTENSION_TRUE' in comments but defaults to disabled (no explicit 'dnssec' setting) in shipped config.

edns_client_subnet_private.description: Enable EDNS client subnet privacy (1 = enabled, 0 = disabled).

idle_timeout.description: Idle timeout in milliseconds for TLS connections (10000 ms = 10 seconds).
